Line 5 = 60,000.00 - 0.00 = 60,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 0 x 1,000.00 = 0.00; line 5 nobody 65 or older: 0.00; line 7 total = 1,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 1,000.00. Line 7 = 60,000.00 - 1,000.00 = 59,000.00. Line 8 = 59,000.00 x 0.03 = 1,770.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 1,770.00.
